clue.text: Adult wrens exercised urge to move

indicators.note: exercised suggests the letters being worked about and stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A grown-up bird, after a workout, feels the itch to travel.
explanation.definitionFit: Wanderlust is the strong desire to travel, a restlessness that makes one want to roam.

clue.text: Almost hold on to fine stray

indicators.note: almost means the word falls just short, losing its final letter

parts.note: to wait is to stay put, keeping on until something happens
F is the pencil-grading abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A plea to keep waiting until a lost animal turns up fine.
explanation.definitionFit: A waif is a homeless, neglected person or animal, a stray.

clue.text: Miss Norway enjoyed exhibition dance, initially

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of each of the four preceding words

explanation.surface: A young Norwegian woman had fun at a dance show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Miss' reads as a title for a young woman from Norway, but it is the verb meaning to lack.
explanation.definitionFit: To miss something is to feel its absence, so to need or want it.

clue.text: Adventurous recording includes quiet knight returning

indicators.note: includes means the recording word holds the next pieces within it

parts.note: entering data is recording it
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet

indicators.note: returning means the knight's title is read backwards

parts.note: a knight is addressed as Sir

explanation.surface: A daring album has a quiet track about a knight coming home.
explanation.definitionFit: An enterprising person shows initiative and boldness, ready to take on new ventures.

clue.text: Reduction in previous tension, happy to follow premier of long film

indicators.note: to follow means this piece comes after the ones before it
the premier of a word is its first, leading letter

parts.note: E.T. is the Spielberg film
up means in good spirits, happy

explanation.surface: After a long film, the audience is happy as the tension finally eases.
explanation.definitionFit: A let-up is a pause or easing, a lessening of pressure that had been there.

clue.text: Avoids angle on staircase

parts.note: a side of an argument is an angle on it
a staircase is a set of steps

explanation.surface: Someone dodges a tricky slant on a set of stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: To sidestep a question or issue is to evade dealing with it.

clue.text: Junk plans rejected

indicators.note: rejected means turned back, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: maps are plans or charts

explanation.surface: Discarded blueprints are tossed aside as rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Spam is unwanted junk email sent in bulk.

clue.text: Swine taking age to evacuate ground finally, having misdirected supporters

parts.note: a pig is a swine
an eon is an age

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of each of the two words before it

explanation.surface: Pigs are moved off the field, with the farmer's helpers sent the wrong way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supporters' means feet here, not fans or helpers.
explanation.definitionFit: Pigeon-toed describes someone whose feet turn inward, so the things that hold them up point askew.

clue.text: Sorcerer arrests first traitor getting justice

indicators.note: arrests means the sorcerer word captures and holds the next pieces

parts.note: a mage is a magician or sorcerer
1ST, with I for the figure one, is first
a rat is a betrayer

explanation.surface: A wizard seizes the leading turncoat so that justice can be done.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Justice' looks abstract, but a justice of the peace is a person, a judge in a minor court.
explanation.definitionFit: A magistrate is a judicial officer, the sort addressed as a justice of the peace.

clue.text: Awkwardness of one getting undressed holding record and bird

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: holding means the undressed word keeps the record and bird inside it

parts.note: undressed means nude
an EP is an extended-play record
a tit is a small bird

explanation.surface: Someone stripped naked clutches a disc and a bird, with clumsy results.
explanation.definitionFit: Ineptitude is a lack of skill, clumsiness or incompetence.

clue.text: Eager to move into silver

indicators.note: into means the moving word is placed inside the silver symbol

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
to go is to move

explanation.surface: Someone keen to invest in silver.
explanation.definitionFit: Agog means full of eager anticipation or excitement.

clue.text: Trying to embrace fashion is very upsetting

indicators.note: to embrace means the trying word wraps itself around the next piece

parts.note: a hearing is a court trying a case
a trend is a fashion

explanation.surface: Struggling to keep up with style is deeply distressing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trying' looks like an adjective meaning difficult; here it is the trying of a case, a hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartrending describes something that causes great sorrow or distress.

clue.text: Ridiculous poseur, dancing clutching Bill

indicators.note: clutching means the jumbled letters grip the bill word in their middle
dancing has the letters of the word jigging about into a new order

parts.note: a bill is a poster stuck up for advertising

explanation.surface: A show-off dances while gripping a bill, looking absurd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clutching' puts POSTER inside PREOUS, the rearranged letters of 'poseur'.
explanation.definitionFit: Preposterous means utterly absurd, contrary to reason.

clue.text: Dominant across old part of Yorkshire

parts.note: over can mean across, as in over the road
Yorkshire was historically divided into three Ridings

explanation.surface: A ruling presence spanning a historic area of northern England.
explanation.walkthrough: A riding was one of the three old administrative divisions of the English county of Yorkshire.
explanation.definitionFit: Overriding means more important than anything else, taking precedence.

clue.text: Taking off with a Parisian, travelling for free

parts.note: un is French for a, as a Parisian would say it
hitching is hitchhiking, getting rides without paying

explanation.surface: A French person sets off, thumbing lifts to save money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking off' suggests departing; here it means removing, as a trailer is unhitched.
explanation.definitionFit: Unhitching is unfastening or detaching, as when a trailer is disconnected from a car.

clue.text: Let out grass around end of April, showing some heart

parts.note: to vent is to let out

indicators.note: around means the grass word sits on either side of the next letter

parts.note: rice is a cereal grass

indicators.note: end of picks the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Releasing a grassy smell late in spring reveals a tender side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Showing some heart' suggests kindness; it means part of the heart itself. Rice counts as a grass botanically.
explanation.definitionFit: A ventricle is one of the two lower chambers of the heart, so a portion of that organ.

clue.text: Clean home out for reptile

indicators.note: out signals that the letters are put out of their order and reset

explanation.surface: A cleaning tip: clear a lizard out of the house.
explanation.definitionFit: A chameleon is a colour-changing lizard, a kind of reptile.

clue.text: Rubbish outside of our bit of machinery

parts.note: rot is nonsense, rubbish

indicators.note: the outside of a word is its two outermost letters

explanation.surface: Junk is piled outside a part of our machine.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotor is the rotating part of a machine such as a motor or helicopter.

clue.text: Checks showers for auditor

indicators.note: an auditor is a listener, so the word is as it would be heard

parts.note: showers of rain are rains

explanation.surface: An accountant inspects the bathrooms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Auditor' suggests an accountant; here it is simply one who hears.
explanation.definitionFit: Reins are restraints, so to rein in is to check or curb.

clue.text: Spongy muscle needs at first to be covered in ice

parts.note: ab is short for an abdominal muscle

indicators.note: to be covered in means the letter sits inside the ice word

parts.note: a sorbet is a water ice

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: An injured muscle needs icing first of all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ice' suggests frozen water for an injury but is a dessert here.
explanation.definitionFit: Something absorbent soaks up liquid, as a sponge does.

clue.text: Old Peruvian slope is glowing

parts.note: Incan describes the Inca people who ruled ancient Peru
a descent is a downward slope

explanation.surface: An ancient Andean hillside is radiant.
explanation.definitionFit: Incandescent means emitting light because of great heat, so shining brightly.

clue.text: Smother husband in drug

indicators.note: in means the husband letter is placed within the drug word

parts.note: coke is slang for cocaine
H is the genealogical abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A husband on drugs is suffocated.
explanation.definitionFit: To choke is to stifle or suffocate, cutting off breath.

clue.text: Bird winning the hearts of rakish showbiz elite

indicators.note: the hearts of words are their central letters, taken from each of the three

explanation.surface: A flighty creature charms raffish celebrities.
explanation.definitionFit: The kiwi is a flightless bird native to New Zealand.

clue.text: Catch small horse

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
a nag is an old horse

explanation.surface: Someone lassos a pony.
explanation.definitionFit: A snag is a hidden problem or drawback, the catch in a deal.

clue.text: Plant is found across Rhode Island

indicators.note: found across means the word is stretched over and around the state abbreviation

parts.note: RI is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Rhode Island

explanation.surface: A plant grows throughout a small New England state.
explanation.definitionFit: The iris is a flowering garden plant with sword-shaped leaves.

clue.text: Protest ignited by institute concerned with ruin

parts.note: a demo is a protest march
lit means set alight, ignited
on means about, concerned with

explanation.surface: A demonstration fired up by a body bent on destruction.
explanation.definitionFit: Demolition is the tearing down of buildings, their destruction.

clue.text: Silences heartless criminal groups

indicators.note: heartless means the central letter is cut out

parts.note: gangs are groups of criminals

explanation.surface: Cruel mobsters keep people quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Gags are pieces of cloth put over the mouth to stop someone speaking.

clue.text: Enticing gin mixed with vile gin

indicators.note: mixed means the letters are blended into a new order, like a cocktail

explanation.surface: A tempting cocktail of gin with nasty gin.
explanation.definitionFit: Inveigling is persuading by flattery or deception, coaxing or luring someone.
